title: Plugin gallery
subtitle: Free, open source additional tools. Each plugin runs separately from the rest of the program, with no access to your computer’s files or to the internet.
noActive: No active plugins. To load one into StarLight, click Enable on its card in the All section.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, author or description
searchCatalogsPlaceholder: Search by name, abbreviation, author or object type

fromFile.catalogQuestion: No connection? Install a catalog locally:
fromFile.catalogArchiveHint: Installs a catalog from a .zip archive containing catalog.json and objects.tsv
fromFile.folderHint: Installs a plugin from a folder containing plugin.json and plugin.js
fromFile.pluginArchiveHint: Installs a plugin from a .zip archive

card.licenseHint: Open source license of the plugin
card.inUseHint: Turned on in the Process step
card.loadedHint: Loaded with StarLight, available in the Process step
card.disabledHint: Installed from a file but disabled: it is not loaded until you enable it again
card.fromFileHint: Installed from a file, not in the gallery
card.useHint: Turns on the plugin in the Process step and opens that step
card.disableHint: The plugin is no longer loaded with StarLight until you enable it again
card.disableNotLoadedHint: The plugin is no longer looked for at startup until you enable it again
card.uninstallHint: Uninstalls the plugin and deletes its folder
card.reenableHint: The plugin is loaded with StarLight again
card.enableHint: The plugin is loaded with StarLight, including the next times you open it, until you disable it

preview.hint: Move the pointer over the preview to move the comparison line between the image before and after the plugin
